source: PyPI public BigQuery dataset (bigquery-public-data.pypi.file_downloads), project maid-runner

semantics.distributionDownloads: Filtered maid-runner distribution file downloads recorded since the November 2025 release (65,525 unfiltered).
semantics.packageManagerDownloads: Distribution downloads whose recorded installer is a standard Python package manager.
semantics.countries: Distinct country codes in the download records.
semantics.limits: Counts include automated and repeated downloads (CI, mirrors, caches) and are not unique users or installs. The MAID Runner CLI collects no usage telemetry.
semantics.refresh: Hand-recorded snapshot from a BigQuery investigation; update updatedAt whenever the counts change.
